payload.name: Paper Trading System
payload.description:
Build a paper trading system that is both:

1. HISTORICAL 90-DAY SEED: Run the last 90 trading days (Mar 25–Jun 20, 2026) through the STEE + MRI overlay entry/exit logic using existing stock_scores and daily_prices data. Record all simulated trades to the swing_trades table with client_id='PAPER_TRADER'. Generate a full 90-day P&L report (outputs/paper_trading_90day.md) with trade list, equity curve, regime-conditional performance, and comparative metrics.

2. LIVE FORWARD TRACKER: Build scripts/papertrader.py that runs daily after market close (or on demand) to:
   - Read the latest stock_scores for all symbols
   - Identify qualifying breakouts using STEE criteria (breakout_10d, volume, close>ema_200, price_quality>=0.7)
   - Require total_score >= 60 for entry, score >= 80 for position size boost
   - Apply regime filter: no new entries in BEARISH
   - Exit existing positions on SL, target_2R, EMA10 trailing stop, or score < 40
   - Insert/Update swing_trades table with PAPER_TRADER client_id
   - Generate daily report: outputs/paper_trade_YYYY-MM-DD.md (open positions, closed positions today, MTM equity)
   - Publish a cumulative ledger: outputs/paper_ledger_latest.md

DATA SOURCES:
- stock_scores (DB): 452K rows, 961 symbols, daily scores from 2024-03-25
- daily_prices (DB CSV backup): 1996-2024 historical prices
- For 90-day historical seed: uses the existing stock_scores DB rows directly
- For live forward: uses signal_generator pipeline (or direct DB query) to get today's scores

DELIVERABLES:
- scripts/papertrader.py (main tracker script, ~150 lines)
- scripts/papertrader_seed.py (90-day historical backfill, ~120 lines)
- DB migration adding PAPER_TRADER client_id enum if needed
- outputs/paper_trading_90day.md (historical report)
- outputs/paper_ledger_latest.md (live cumulative ledger)
- docs/PAPER_TRADING_PLAN.md (architecture + data flow + next steps)

CRITERIA:
- Historical seed produces ≥20 trades over 90 days
- Live tracker script is runnable from CLI without LLM calls
- All trades written to swing_trades table with full metadata
- Daily reports are human-readable markdown
- Zero regressions: no modifications to engine_core/ or api/
- Honest reporting: includes drawdowns and loss trades alongside wins

goal.answer: Build paper trading system: historical 90-day seed + live forward tracker, recording to swing_trades, generating honest markdown reports.

phases.answer: Phase 1: Build Seed Script + Run 90-Day Simulation, Phase 2: Build Live Forward Tracker, Phase 3: Documentation + Zero-Regression Verification

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 1: Build Seed Script + Run 90-Day Simulation
phaseSnapshots.goal: 90-day historical seed script, DB writes, and report generation
phaseSnapshots.description: Build scripts/papertrader_seed.py that reads stock_scores and daily_prices for the last 90 trading days, simulates STEE+MScore entry/exit logic day-by-day, writes paper trades to swing_trades, and generates outputs/paper_trading_90day.md with equity curve and metrics. Shared signal_entry() and evaluate_exit() functions are defined here for reuse.

steps.description: Write scripts/papertrader_seed.py with STEE+MScore logic and shared functions
Run 90-day seed and write trades to swing_trades

verification.command: python3 scripts/papertrader_seed.py && python3 -c "from engine_core.db import get_connection; c=get_connection().cursor(); c.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM swing_trades WHERE client_id is not null\"); print(c.fetchone()[0] or 0)"

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 2: Build Live Forward Tracker
phaseSnapshots.goal: Live forward tracker script with daily CLI execution
phaseSnapshots.description: Build scripts/papertrader.py live tracker reusing Phase 1's signal_entry and evaluate_exit functions. Runs daily with CLI args, processes open position exits and new entries, writes to swing_trades, generates outputs/paper_trade_YYYY-MM-DD.md and outputs/paper_ledger_latest.md.

steps.description: Write scripts/papertrader.py importing shared functions from Phase 1
Run one-day demo to generate daily report + cumulative ledger

verification.command: python3 scripts/papertrader.py --date 2026-06-19 --dry-run && wc -l outputs/paper_trade_2026-06-19.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'dry run ok'

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 3: Documentation + Zero-Regression Verification
phaseSnapshots.description: Write docs/PAPER_TRADING_PLAN.md architecture doc, update Sessions.md, verify zero regressions, stage all new files, and commit to feature/data-richness.

verification.command: git diff --name-only | grep -v '^scripts/' | grep -v '^outputs/' | grep -v '^docs/' | grep -v 'Sessions.md' | grep -v 'Progress.md' | grep -v '.gitignore' | grep -v '^\.kimchi' | wc -l | awk '{exit $1}'

assumptions.answer: swing_trades.client_id (uuid) exists; a sentinel UUID isolates paper trades from live data.; stock_scores spans 2024-03-25 to 2026-06-19 (581 trading days). 90-day seed window is last 90 trading days.; The user wants both historical seed and live tracker for credibility.; No DB migration needed; client_id already exists.; Reusable entry/exit functions shared between seed and live tracker to avoid drift.; Zero regressions requires no edits to engine_core/, engine_debate/, api/, or tests.; Exit reasons encoded as: SL, TARGET, TRAILING_STOP, SCORE_EXIT, REGIME_EXIT, MANUAL.
